response.rationale: Pick the tower over the chapel because the dozer can't open the access for both in time. The dozer opens hospital then marina access (0-6), then cuts lines that depend on the world. The engine does mill, relay, then tower. The helicopter drops on airstrip, shelter and granary before the reveal, then uses the last 2 water on bakery (alpha) or village (beta). There is no survey because it would cost 5 and lose the airstrip. Expected value is about 567.8.

Crew-1 then does station 879 and substation 590 in both worlds. Engine-1 does bakery 760 and pumphouse 462 in alpha, and marina 433, intake 129 and pumphouse 462 in beta. Expected net value is about 329.7.

The plan uses all 6 water on airstrip, shelter and granary (committed before the tick-6 reveal) plus one world-specific 2-water wetline: bakery in alpha, village in beta. Mill (806) is beta-only on engine-1 after the tower. Survey 974 is skipped because its 5-unit cost and engine/heli time outweigh the small gain from earlier information.

Expected net value is about 567.8 (alpha 497, beta 615).
